purpose: Teach: ダブル/ショット/直感/展覧/演じる/細い/逃げる/助ける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祝いに、本気で、絶対、ダブル、絶対、サイズの、絶対、ケーキ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼んでみるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm thinking of ordering a real celebration cake — a double-size one, seriously.
lines.style: Warm, generous energy. Opens bright and purposeful. Slight lift on 'double-size' — already imagining it. Conversational pace, intimate like she's sharing a plan with someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、エスプレッソ、絶対、ショット、絶対、追加、絶対、できるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, I can definitely add an extra espresso shot for you — no problem.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and capable. Quick, efficient delivery without rushing. The ease of someone who knows her menu and her customers. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の好みを、絶対、直感、絶対、で、絶対、見抜くよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, Aoi has this way of just reading what customers actually want — I really do admire that.
lines.style: Sincere and observant. Slower pace on 'reading what customers want' — genuine compliment, not performative. Trailing warmth at the end. Direct, like she's noticing something out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、絵画、絶対、展覧、絶対、会、絶対、見てきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and Aoi went to see a friend's art exhibition recently — did I tell you that?
lines.style: Lighter, conversational energy. Quick and engaged, like she's recalling something pleasant. Slight lift on 'art exhibition' — sharing something good. Natural pacing, no heaviness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、巫女、絶対、役を、絶対、演じる、絶対、らしいわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently she's going to be playing a shrine maiden at the festival coming up.
lines.style: Brighter, almost playful anticipation. Opens with that eager rhythm. The slight breathiness of imagining something fun. Lilting on the ending — like 'can you picture that?'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、細い、絶対、フォーク、絶対、お店に、絶対、揃えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's been stocking the shop with these really delicate forks lately.
lines.style: Practical observation, grounded tone. Steady pace. Not performing surprise, just noting a detail she's noticed. The voice of someone who pays attention to small things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お店の前で、本気で、絶対、お客様が、絶対、傘から、絶対、逃げる、絶対、ように、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、駆け込んだわ
lines.en: There was a customer outside the shop the other day who was caught in the rain, and I just rushed in without thinking.
lines.style: Slightly breathless recollection, warm and unguarded. The pace quickens slightly on 'rushed in' — less thought, more instinct. Trailing gently, like she's a bit embarrassed by her own reflexiveness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の困った時、絶対、助ける、絶対、ように、絶対、心がけてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I just try to help whenever I see a customer struggling with something — it's the only way I know how.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slower, measured pace. No bravado, no self-consciousness. The kind of honesty that comes from someone who doesn't think what she's saying is remarkable. Gentle close.
